name: ThermoBeacon (additional types)
notes: Additional ThermoBeacon/Brifit sensor types 0x14 and 0x30 (manufacturer-data leading byte read as pseudo company ID, the same encoding the Theengs WS02-WS08 fleet uses for types 0x10/0x11/0x15/0x18/0x1B). Source: Bluetooth-Devices/thermobeacon-ble DEVICE_TYPES (MIT).
